✨【Product Parameters 】

✅【Multi-function Grass Trimmer】: 4-in-1 Grass Trimmer/wheel edger /Mini-Mower / Brush cutter.

✅【Super long battery life】: Comes with 2x21V 8.0AH batteries, You don't have to worry about battery life , two 8.0AH batteries can meet all your daily cleaning needs.

✅【With trimming auxiliary wheels】：Just rotate the machine head, Install mowing lines Turn into wheel edger in seconds, Support and guide the edger, giving you straighter lines and cleaner cuts.

✅【3 Types of Cutting Blades】: The weed wacker with different blades to meet different weeding needs. Plastic blade, suitable for cutting grass; stainless steel blade, suitable for fast cutting lawn, weeds, small shrubs; manganese steel circular saw blade, strong cutting ability, suitable for cutting thick shrub branches.

✅【Safety with Multiple Protection and Converts Edger Lawn in Seconds】:Weed eater battery trimmer added a safety lock button to prevent accidental start.You need to press the safety button and switch simultaneously to start the edger.Multifunctional design with Adjustable Machine Head for easy cutting at hard to reach areas.Press the adjustable machine head's button to Convert trimmer to an edger in seconds easily.
